api_messages: For searches, time period start and end dates are currently limited to an earliest date of 2007-10-01.  For data going back to 2000-10-01, use either the Custom Award Download feature on the website or one of our download or bulk_download API endpoints as listed on https://api.usaspending.gov/docs/endpoints.
The 'subawards' field will be deprecated in the future. Set 'spending_level' to 'subawards' instead. See documentation for more information.
snapshot.dataset: USAspending.gov search/spending_by_geography, VA contracts by county place of performance
notes: Amounts are federal action obligations aggregated by USAspending county geography for contract-type awards.
Geography is place of performance, not recipient headquarters and not proof that a specific VA facility received that amount.
Negative values can appear when deobligations exceed new obligations in the selected period.

source_policy: Only USAspending.gov, a federal .gov source, is used for this VA contract geography snapshot. The public site reads this locally bundled JSON; it does not call USAspending live in the browser.
